title: Blocked result
description: The fail-closed result every deterministic script returns on stdout, with exit code 2, whenever it cannot proceed safely. Never silently treat an omitted finding as applied or a skipped edit as successful — a blocked result is the only way a script reports failure.

stage.description: Which pipeline stage produced the block, e.g. 'classify', 'derive_finding_id', 'checkpoint_state.create', 'reconcile_decision', 'render_diff'.

detail.description: The failing transition or field, in plain language.

recovery_action.description: What the caller (host adapter or command) should do next.
